title: Georgina Waterfront Festival
priceNote: Concert lawn free; midway ride bracelets available on-site.
summary: Lakefront concerts, culinary pop-ups, artisan vendors, paddle demos and nightly fireworks transform Georgina's harbour into a three-day Canada Day celebration.
description: Kick off Canada Day weekend with shoreline concerts, a craft beverage garden, Indigenous dance performances, paddleboard and kayak try-it sessions, and nightly fireworks over Lake Simcoe. Family zone features inflatable fun, face painting and STEM makerspace hosted by the local library. Please bring reusable bottles; hydration stations provided.
